ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpUp PrivEsc Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of SharpUp, a tool for local privilege escalation

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpUp\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "SharpUp" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*HijackablePaths.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UnquotedServicePath.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ProcessDLLHijack.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ModifiableServiceBinaries.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ModifiableScheduledTask.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DomainGPPPassword.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CachedGPPPassword.*")))
